description: This script collects and outputs system environment information related to PyTorch, CUDA, hardware, and software configurations, primarily for debugging and reporting purposes.

classes.name: SystemEnv
classes.description: Named tuple containing various system environment details such as versions, hardware info, and package lists.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns its return code, output, and error messages.

methods.name: run_and_read_all
methods.description: Runs a command and returns the entire output if the command succeeds.

methods.name: run_and_parse_first_match
methods.description: Runs a command and returns the first regex match from its output.

methods.name: run_and_return_first_line
methods.description: Runs a command and returns its first line of output.
